topic: Choose a summer camp activity week for the kids

scenario.topic: Choose a summer camp activity week for the kids
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for the kids' summer camp week: learning new skills, having fun outdoors, or trying something creative?

options.name: Beginner Sailing and Water Safety Course
options.upside: Teaches practical water skills and confidence on the water
options.tradeoff: Requires good weather and may be tiring for some kids
options.concern: Parents worried about water safety despite supervision
options.best_for: kids interested in outdoor adventure and water activities

options.name: Creative Arts and Crafts Workshop
options.upside: Encourages creativity and fine motor skills with diverse projects
options.tradeoff: Less physical activity and outdoor time during the week
options.concern: Some kids may find it less engaging or too quiet
options.best_for: kids who enjoy hands-on creative expression and calm settings

options.name: Forest Adventure and Wildlife Exploration
options.upside: Immerses kids in nature with guided hikes and animal tracking
options.tradeoff: Long outdoor hours may be exhausting or challenging for some
options.concern: Concerns about insect bites or minor scrapes during hikes
options.best_for: kids who love nature and physical activity

options.name: Robotics and Coding Fundamentals Camp
options.upside: Builds STEM skills with hands-on robot building and programming
options.tradeoff: Less outdoor time and higher cost than other options
options.concern: Some kids may find screen time or technical focus less fun
options.best_for: kids interested in technology and problem-solving

shared_context: The camp week runs Monday to Friday from 9am to 4pm
The budget per child for the activity week is fixed at $300
There are exactly 5 kids in the group participating together
